# Implementer

In the consent script, the questionnaire informs respondents who is conducting the survey and who to contact in the event of concerns or questions.

To provide these values, navigate to the following variables in [section 0](https://designer.mysurvey.solutions/q/details/634a3bb2e2914cbdbef06b760655c4e2/chapter/4d0297a8722c3f3c745264fc662e9fda/group/4d0297a8722c3f3c745264fc662e9fda):

- `name_of_survey_firm`. Name of the survey firm.
- `survey_phone_number`. Phone number for the survey firm's contact person.
- `survey_contact_person`. Name of the survey firm's contact person.

For more details on the process, read [here](variable_values.qmd).
